summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration 2 (Insights tab, Share Snapshot, dotted world map, ?tab= deep-link, and Upload/Animal regressions). All new features and regressions passed. Insights tab renders stats-average-score gauge (avg ~57 shown, ~53 text — animation state; matches spec ballpark ~53), four stat cards (Total Posts=5, Median Range 32-88, Healthiest 88 Amazon, Most At Risk 32 Sahel), stats-distribution bars (Healthy 2/40%, At Risk 2/40%, Critical 1/20% — matches spec 2/2/1). Share Snapshot: post-share-button in modal triggered html2canvas -> PNG download ('biodash-Sundarbans,-India.png') with success toast 'Snapshot downloaded' and no error toast or console/pageerror. Map: dotted world map renders in map-container-2d with 5 map-pin-item pins; filters healthy=2, critical=1. Deep-links /?tab=insights and /?tab=map open correct tabs. Regression Upload: habitat-file-input -> habitat-analyze-button -> habitat-score-display (score=15) + habitat-summary-text rendered, map click set location, habitat-save-post-button saved (persisted, cleaned up). Regression Animal: animal-file-input -> animal-identify-button -> animal-result-card with animal-species-name='No animal detected' and animal-habitat-loss-summary (expected behavior for synthetic image per prior iteration).

issues: Gauge animated value (57) briefly differs from computed text (53) during entry animation — cosmetic only, resolves after animation.

critical_code_review_comments: HabitatMapTab.shareSnapshot: If html2canvas fails on tainted image (post.image_base64 for seed URLs), a generic 'Could not create snapshot' toast fires but no console error is logged — consider console.error(e) in catch for observability.

ShareCard.jsx uses crossOrigin='anonymous' on which is correct for the base64 data URLs but for the Unsplash seed URLs relies on Unsplash serving CORS headers — seed posts share fine in this test but any future non-CORS host would silently taint.
StatsTab: uses posts prop only; when zero posts shows placeholder — OK. tiers key 'moderate' matches scoreTier() output; verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Insights, Share Snapshot download+toast, dotted map, filters, deep-links, Upload+Save, Animal)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 test habitat posts during Upload regression (Freshwater Stream, Dense Forest Canopy) and cleaned them up via DELETE /api/habitat/posts/{id}. DB left with original 5 seed posts.
